verdicts_or_reports.expected: While Anonymous remains checked, username and password remain disabled after rotation.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After portrait-landscape-portrait rotation, Anonymous stays checked but both credential fields become enabled. Tapping username focuses it and opens the keyboard. Reproduced twice.
steps: Open + > Cloud Connection > SMB Connection > Enter hostname manually.
Enter qa_user and qa_pass in credentials, dismiss keyboard.
Check Anonymous and verify both fields disabled.
Rotate landscape then portrait.
Tap Username; it is editable while Anonymous is checked.
Toggle Anonymous off/on and repeat rotation to reproduce.

verdicts_or_reports.element: Username editable with Anonymous checked following rotation
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Anonymous checked must keep credential fields greyed out and prevent editing, including after recreation.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Confirmed by actually changing Username from qa_user to edited_while_anonymous while Anonymous remained checked after rotating. Password is also enabled. Empty hostname was left untouched; Address cannot be empty appears following rotation.
steps: In portrait open Cloud Connection > SMB Connection > ENTER HOSTNAME MANUALLY.
Leave hostname empty; enter username qa_user and password qa_pass; hide keyboard.
Check Anonymous: credential fields become disabled.
Rotate to landscape and back to portrait.
Without toggling Anonymous, tap Username and replace it with edited_while_anonymous.
Hide keyboard: Anonymous is still checked and new username is shown.
Repeated off/on then landscape/portrait reproduced the enabled fields.

verdicts_or_reports.element: Paste conflict and pending paste controls
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Rotation retains or restores the pending conflict dialog and allows completing the paste.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Rotating while the Alpha conflict is open removes both the conflict dialog and the pending paste bar. Destination still shows 1 folders and 1 files. Repeated twice, once with Do for all items checked and once unchecked.
steps: Copy AndroidQA/Amaze/Alpha using its Properties menu > Copy.
Open Beta, which already contains a copied Alpha folder.
Tap PASTE to show conflict for Alpha.
Rotate landscape then portrait without choosing Skip, Overwrite or Rename.
Observe no conflict dialog or Paste control remains.
Repeat copy/paste and rotation; same result.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Opening a saved anonymous SMB connection initializes username/password as disabled and greyed out.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: On reopening a saved anonymous connection, Anonymous is checked but credential fields are enabled. Reopened twice; typed anonymous_edit_test into Username without unchecking Anonymous.
steps: Create SMB connection for hostname 192.0.2.1 with Anonymous checked.
Open navigation drawer and tap edit button beside SMB Connection.
Observe Anonymous checked but Username and Password enabled.
Cancel and reopen edit to reproduce.
Type anonymous_edit_test into Username while Anonymous remains checked.
